keyPhrases.text: Sadly, the show fails to keep faith with its source material
proving to be an uneven mixture of satire and wistfulness
There is great material to work with here
the show's creators aren't sure whether to present a childhood fantasy or a dark allegory
doing a music number introducing each one feels like overkill
feels like an effort to unnecessarily pad the show
There are also a few gaps of logic in the overall narrative
the musical numbers...are not nearly as strong

reasoning: Review acknowledges some strong source material and positive audience reaction, but consistently criticizes execution with phrases like 'fails to keep faith,' 'uneven mixture,' creators being 'unsure,' and structural problems. More criticisms than praise throughout.
